capabilities: Visualize vault storage as treemap, sunburst, donut and bar charts with drill-down navigation
Rank and filter largest files with open, copy-path and file-manager actions
Scan for orphan attachments using resolved links, metadata links and a regex body fallback
Track 12-month size growth, edit-activity heatmap and recent note activity
Display a customizable vault identity badge in the right sidebar
extras: Deep body-text orphan scan is flagged as high performance cost and off by default; desktop-only features (disk estimate, reveal in file manager) are hidden on mobile; bilingual UI requires Obsidian 1.8.7 or later.
problem: Obsidian gives no built-in overview of what occupies vault storage, how file sizes are distributed, or which attachments are unreferenced by any note.
summary: Vault analysis dashboard that visualizes storage composition as treemap/sunburst charts, ranks largest files, and detects orphan attachments.
